original_test_intent: Verify that the BMC Hardware Status Sensors view completely and correctly represents all sensors applicable to the configured SUT according to the platform specification.
original_method: Bind the SUT/BMC configuration to a fitted-hardware sensor matrix, capture every BMC Sensors category/page and structured record, compare label, entity association, reading, unit, status, thresholds and freshness with the approved schema including allowed absent/disabled states, then reconcile full same-target SDR/IPMI data only where mappings are documented, without changing thresholds or generating stimuli.
manual_activity: The platform owner supplies the complete sensor coverage matrix and exception semantics; an operator verifies configuration and UI-only fields while automation captures, normalizes and compares the full read-only dataset.
required_inputs: Complete expected sensor list by component/entity
Expected units, thresholds, status meanings and tolerances
Supported complete BMC Web/API capture path
Protected credentials and evidence redaction policy
safety_requirements: Do not clear kernel, SEL, audit or BMC logs
Do not alter thresholds, fan curves, power limits or BMC configuration
Do not generate thermal or fault stimulus for this display case
Never truncate evidence intended to prove completeness
Protect credentials and sensitive platform identity
Stop on target mismatch, stale/malformed data or unknown mapping
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and fitted hardware inventory
Capture all BMC Sensors categories/pages or complete API
Extract every field and freshness marker
Collect full same-target SDR/IPMI data as documented corroboration
Compare coverage and values with the owner matrix
Preserve logs and report without formal verdict
engineer_actions: Supply and approve the sensor matrix and mapping
Define absence, stale and non-threshold semantics
Verify fitted configuration and UI-only behavior
Resolve unmapped, missing or alarmed sensors

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: IPMI SDR/sensor reads can corroborate mapped fields, but `head` truncation cannot prove completeness, the commands omit the source's BMC Web path and password arguments are unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture the complete protected BMC Hardware Status Sensors view/API with all categories and pages, then obtain untruncated SDR/IPMI output for the same target/time and compare only documented mappings to the fitted-hardware SPEC matrix.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All sensor information, BMC Web path, SPEC comparison and 20/20-minute estimates are preserved; no mutation or stress is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a coverage matrix from the approved fitted BOM/topology, with one row per expected sensor containing Web/API identity, association, value/unit/status/threshold/freshness, allowed exception and mapped SDR record, preserving unmatched records on both sides.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes `all` and `match SPEC` objective while retaining the read-only Web inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A truncated IPMI dump cannot establish Web UI completeness or UI-only fields; conversely, UI capture without expected inventory cannot show missing sensors.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Dynamic readings may vary between captures, and some sensors are discrete or non-threshold; forcing a numeric equality or threshold schema onto every type would create false failures.

project_override_considerations: The Project must bind the matrix to the exact fitted SKU and define how optional/unpopulated hardware appears. An API may replace manual page traversal only if it demonstrably covers every UI category and field required by the source.
expected_evidence: Verified target/firmware/UI and fitted hardware/topology inventory
Approved complete sensor matrix, mappings, units/threshold/status/freshness and exception rules
Full BMC Web/API capture for every category/page with raw artifact hashes
Untruncated same-target SDR/IPMI supporting output and timestamps
Expected, observed, missing, extra, duplicate, stale, malformed and mismatched per-field report
Relevant BMC/OS/SEL evidence, no-mutation/security audit and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require all BMC sensor information to match the specification. The source omits the matrix but does not present competing targets or oracles.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The fitted sensor matrix, vendor schema and protected Web/API access are normal project/vendor inputs; the complete read-only validation objective is clear.

review_improvement: Turns a truncated generic dump into a configuration-aware completeness and field-correctness audit of the literal BMC Sensors view, including explicit exception and freshness semantics.
independent_technical_reasoning: `All sensors` is defined by the fitted platform specification, not by however many rows a command happens to print. Completeness requires reconciling expected and observed identities in both directions, while correctness depends on sensor type: analog, discrete and non-threshold records have different fields. Preserving unmatched and raw records prevents normalization from hiding omissions.
